dedupe_keys.name: building permits city of chicago data portal

description: Building permits issued by the City of Chicago Department of Buildings from 2006 to the present, excluding permits voided or revoked after issue. Each row is one permit with its number, status and milestone, permit and review type, application start and issue dates, processing time, address, work type and work description, permit conditions, fees paid, unpaid and waived by building, zoning and other category, and up to several contacts. Coverage: the whole city; the API counted 848,664 permits with issue dates from January 2006 to 27 September 2026. Format and access: free CSV, JSON or Socrata API, updated daily; the licence field says to see the terms of use. Caveats: permit data record permitted work and not completed construction, and the contact fields hold names of applicants. Useful for tracking building renovation and new construction activity, stock change and permitting workload in scenario and capacity planning; related records are not yet linked.
